name: new_v2_roam_static_resting_synthetic_quality_v1

fault_definitions.dropout_ch0..7: Set the named EMG channel to zero in every held-out window; test all eight channel placements separately
fault_definitions.gain_half_all: Multiply all eight held-out channels by 0.5
fault_definitions.clip_q95_all: Clip each channel to its symmetric source-subject retained resting-posture window 95th absolute-sample percentile; not an ADC clipping claim
fault_definitions.line50_half_rms_all: Add a common-phase 50 Hz sine at 0.5 times each channel's source-subject retained resting-posture window RMS
fault_definitions.baseline_ramp_half_rms_all: Add a linear -0.5 to +0.5 source-window RMS drift to each channel over each 200 ms window
fault_definitions.burst_ch0_2q95: Add an eight-sample Hann burst of amplitude 2 times source-window channel-0 q95 absolute amplitude at samples 16..23 of every held-out window

source_state: F0v2 Rest thresholds, source q95/RMS corruption references, feature metadata, scaler and classifier fit only source subjects 1-18 resting. No target or final signal fits state. Every corruption is applied only to a copy of the identical target native-bout windows.
classifier: Same source-only balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260929 as frozen ROAM posture study; clean resting predictions must replay byte-level values within 1e-10
selection: No arm or fault selection by final results; preserve F0v2 choice from frozen posture validation. Fault family and strength fixed before this experiment.
quality_summary: Six family coordinates: mean of eight dropout-channel macro-F1 values, and individual gain, clipping, line-noise, baseline-ramp and burst macro-F1 values; equal mean and minimum of six coordinates. Clean is a matched control, excluded from corrupted-quality mean.
scope: Synthetic test-only corruptions on public Myo eight-channel 200 Hz static resting bouts. Same held-out users and native bouts are paired across faults and arms; no measured hardware-fault labels, 250 Hz device, live transitions or real quality prevalence claim.
